questions.q: What is the main purpose of Python?
options: To solve problems within its own domain
questions.explanation: Python exists to address problems within its own domain.

questions.q: What is the best way to confirm a change to Python work is safe?
options: Write automated tests around the behaviour
Skip code review to save time
Assume it works if it runs once
questions.explanation: Automated tests give repeatable evidence that behaviour is preserved.

questions.q: Which task best demonstrates intermediate ability in Python?
options: Build a small end-to-end feature with minimal guidance
Lead architecture reviews for a large team
questions.explanation: That task matches the expectations of level 3.

questions.q: What is the best first step when debugging a Python problem?
options: Reproduce the issue with a minimal example
Change unrelated configuration until it works
questions.explanation: A minimal reproduction makes the cause easier to isolate.

questions.q: Which habit best supports steady improvement in Python?
questions.explanation: Deliberate practice with feedback turns knowledge into skill.
